subject.title: refactor: move non-session runtime journals to SQLite

question: Should this migration preserve the shipped ACP diagnostic handle and filesystem-oriented plugin artifact semantics through compatibility/query APIs before merge, or intentionally break those contracts in this release?
rationale: The repository policy favors SQLite-only runtime state, but it also treats shipped CLI and plugin SDK contracts as compatibility-sensitive; choosing whether and how those observable contracts change requires explicit maintainer intent.

options.title: Preserve access contracts
options.body: Add stable SQLite-backed read/export APIs and retain compatible result and artifact behavior before merging the storage flip.

options.title: Approve a breaking transition
options.body: Land the removals only with an explicit deprecation or release boundary, upgrade documentation, and real operator migration proof.

options.title: Narrow the migration
options.body: Merge only journal surfaces that have complete operator and plugin compatibility paths, leaving the others for focused follow-up work.

recommendation.title: Preserve access contracts
recommendation.body: Add stable SQLite-backed read/export APIs and retain compatible result and artifact behavior before merging the storage flip.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent cross-cutting history across storage, memory, and runtime contract work represented by the PR.
